lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ho₂In₄Cd₂ (reduced formula HoIn₂Cd) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Immm (No. 216), with eight atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis gives Cd centers nine In neighbors (3.17–3.61 Å), Ho centers ten In neighbors (3.17–3.45 Å), and In centers seven neighbors (4 Cd, 3 Ho). The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all eight sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between Cd and Ho 9- and 10-vertex polyhedra, and corner, edge, and face sharing among In 7-vertex polyhedra.
